issue_context.title: Create issue with `--web` misses `--label` args
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug

`--label` flags seem to get dropped when creating an issue with `--web`

```
❯ gh version
gh version 0.8.0 (2020-05-11)
```

### Steps to reproduce the behavior

1. Type this `gh issue create --title foo --label bar --web`
2. Note lack of assigned `bar` label on sidebar

### Expected vs actual behavior

Title and body work fine. Labels seem to just go missing even though they're definitely supported via GET query params.
comments:
Looks like we have skipped this part(labels, milestones, projects, assignee).  
I can take this up, @mislav @vilmibm

@AliabbasMerchant You are welcome to, but ~~it's not possible to combine `--draft`, `--label`, `--milestone`, `--project`, `--assignee`, or `--reviewer` with `--web`, since our web UI only accepts title & body as query parameters.~~

So maybe you could open a pull request that raises an error if any of the above listed flags were used in combination with `--web`?

Can't we start respecting those values/flags also, when using `--web`? GitHub does support setting them using query params.

https://help.github.com/en/github/managing-your-work-on-github/about-automation-for-issues-and-pull-requests-with-query-parameters#supported-query-parameters

~we should definitely start printing a warning when about unsupported query parameters (like draft) when -w is used; it will at least give a user context when they flip back to their terminal.~ edit: apparently we already do this

Thought I’d note that this is regarding _issue_ creation which appears to support labels via web. 

Pull request creation warns about using draft and web as @mislav described in the latest release.
